provenance_note: Compiled by the Materia project from the cited primary sources. Stacking ABAC (Ramsdell ABCB): Si on 2a (0, 0, 0) and 2b (1/3, 2/3, 1/4) of P6_3mc, the 2a layers being the quasi-cubic (k) sites and the 2b layers the hexagonal (h) sites, with C above each Si at z + u. The internal parameter u is taken at the ideal value 3/16; measured deviations are below 0.5 %. No published Stillinger-Weber parameterisation for SiC is bundled in v0.1. The generic Lennard-Jones model is offered for interactive geometry only and is qualitative for a covalent polar crystal; use an external solver for energetics.
